title: Slime Siege Runner
heading: Slime Siege
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Drag a cannon from the shop (bottom left) anywhere on the meadow; click a fixed cannon to turn it; pick a tool, then click a cannon.

1.name: Slimes
1.note: Clones head for the keep: point towards, then turn by a wave.

2.name: Cannons
2.note: Click the shop and drag; click a placed cannon to turn it 45°.

3.name: Shooting
3.note: Bolts are clones of their cannon, flying the way it points.

4.name: Hits and coins
4.note: Touching the bolt colour hurts slimes; a slime at the keep costs a life.

5.name: The seeker
5.note: The slime closest to the keep reports its place; Target goes there; seekers point towards Target.

6.name: Chewing and repair
6.note: Slimes chew cannons in their way; Repair mends them.

7.name: Upgrades
7.note: Speed, Damage, Pierce, Strength: each cannon keeps its own.

8.name: Waves
8.note: Tougher, faster slimes from more sides; a boss every fifth wave. The whole game.
